title: genai scorer provenance: registered scorer_version does not survive serialization, so async scorer and evaluate jobs must pass it as a separate parameter
answers: Assessments from the UI scorer invoke or async evaluate run are missing scorerName and scorerVersion metadata
Why does a registered scorer's version come back as None after it runs as a background job?
Where is the scorer version restored for online monitoring or trace-level scoring jobs?
How do I add another field to the scorer/invoke or genai/evaluate/invoke job payload?
body:
Path: Background scorer execution that rebuilds a Scorer from a stored JSON payload: mlflow/genai/scorers/job.py:invoke_scorer_job (scorer/invoke trace scoring), mlflow/genai/evaluation/job.py:invoke_genai_evaluate_job (genai/evaluate/invoke), and the online run_online_trace_scorer_job / run_online_session_scorer_job, which feed mlflow/genai/scorers/online/sampler.py. Handler entry points are mlflow/server/handlers.py:_invoke_scorer_handler and _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler.
Rule: Scorer.scorer_version is a PrivateAttr left out of model_dump, so Scorer.model_validate_json never restores it. Send the registered version as its own job param (scorer_version / scorer_versions, parallel to serialized_scorers) and reapply it with Scorer._set_registration_metadata(..., scorer_version=...) after deserializing. The handlers resolve the stored scorer with tracking_store.get_scorer(experiment_id, name, version) and submit that record's canonical serialized_scorer together with the resolved scorer_version, not the client's copy.
Symptom: Assessments produced by the UI-triggered async scorer or evaluate runs carried no mlflow.assessment.scorerName / scorerVersion, even though the same scorer run synchronously recorded them.
Constraints: Only applies when a version is set; unregistered scorers pass None and get no provenance. scorer_versions must match serialized_scorers in length (rejected with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE in the handler and in the job). Trace-level and online paths both need this; the job itself does not look up the store.
applies: Any async/background job that rebuilds a Scorer from serialized JSON and must keep registered provenance; scorer/invoke, genai/evaluate/invoke and online monitoring.
says: Assessments created by background evaluation jobs are missing scorer name and version tags.
Running an evaluator asynchronously from the UI drops the judge version on results.
Asynchronous scoring runs should record the same evaluator version metadata as synchronous runs.
Online trace monitoring jobs generate assessment scores with empty scorer version labels.
Preserve the registered scorer version when launching evaluation tasks in the background.
search: Because `Scorer.scorer_version` is a private attribute omitted during JSON serialization, asynchronous evaluation and scorer background jobs must transmit `scorer_version` or `scorer_versions` as an explicit job parameter and restore it with `Scorer._set_registration_metadata` after deserialization. Route handlers `_invoke_scorer_handler` and `_invoke_genai_evaluate_handler` resolve canonical scorers via `tracking_store.get_scorer` and submit the stored record's serialized payload alongside the resolved version. This mechanism applies to `invoke_scorer_job`, `invoke_genai_evaluate_job`, and online monitoring jobs (`run_online_trace_scorer_job`, `run_online_session_scorer_job`). Unregistered scorers pass `None`, and the length of `scorer_versions` must match `serialized_scorers` or the job is rejected with `INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE`.
